info.title: BrightPath API
info.description:
Backend API for BrightPath: NEET rank predictor, college finder and student enquiries.

This spec is the contract for the frontend. Every route documents its summary, parameters, request body and responses. Exported to `docs/openapi.json` via `bun run openapi:export`.

**Errors.** Every non-2xx response uses one body shape, `{ error: { code, message, fields?, requestId } }`. `fields` lists per-field problems for form validation (HTTP 422). `requestId` matches the `X-Request-Id` header.

**Empty query values.** A query parameter sent with an empty value (`?limit=`) is treated as not provided.

**Rate limits.** Public routes are limited per IP. When exceeded the API answers 429 with a `Retry-After` header.

**Staff auth.** `/admin/*` routes need a staff session: `POST /admin/auth/login` sets an httpOnly `bp_session` cookie; send requests with credentials. Writes must also send `X-BP-Admin: 1`. Roles: ADMIN (everything), EDITOR (content and data), COUNSELLOR (enquiries). 401 = not logged in, 403 = not allowed.

**Changelog.** 0.3.1: blank query parameters are treated as not provided. 0.3.0: staff login/roles, staff management, site settings, versioned disclaimers, audit log, `GET /site/config`. 0.2.0: foundation (error envelope, request ids, rate limiting, security headers).

get.description: Probes Postgres and Redis. Returns 200 when both are reachable, 503 when any dependency is down. Use this for container/orchestrator health checks and for the frontend to detect an unavailable backend.

uptimeSeconds.description: Seconds since the API process started

503.description: At least one dependency is down

schema.description: At least one dependency is down

get.description: Everything the frontend needs on every page, in one cacheable call: brand name, contact details (null until the owner adds them), the finder's free-results count, and the current disclaimer texts. Disclaimer `version` 0 means the built-in default is in use. Supports `ETag` / `If-None-Match` (answers 304 with an empty body when unchanged).

post.description: Starts a staff session and sets the `bp_session` cookie (httpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Secure in production). Wrong email and wrong password give the same 401 message. After 5 wrong passwords the account is locked for 15 minutes (429). Limited to 10 attempts per minute per IP. Cookie-authenticated writes must send the header `X-BP-Admin: 1` (CSRF protection); the browser also sends an `Origin` that must be on the allow-list.
